text.title: Two Hotels in Miami Beach
paragraphs: Last month, I spent two nights in two different hotels in Miami Beach. Here is my [[comparison]].

The Palm Hotel is cheaper than the Sea Breeze: $120 a night [[instead of]] $180. It's also closer to the beach, only two minutes away. But the rooms are smaller, and the beds are less [[comfortable]].

The Sea Breeze is more expensive, but it's newer and much quieter. The [[staff]] were friendlier, and the breakfast was better: fresh fruit, eggs and great coffee. At the Palm, the breakfast was worse: just bread and juice.

So, is the Palm as nice as the Sea Breeze? Not really. But it isn't as expensive, [[either]]. If you want to save money and spend all day at the beach, choose the Palm. If you want to rest, the Sea Breeze is the better [[choice]].
My rating: the Palm, 3 out of 5. The Sea Breeze, 4 out of 5.

either.note: No fim de uma frase negativa: "it isn't expensive, either" = "também não é caro".

grammar.title: Comparativos: mais barato, mais caro, tão bom quanto
explanation: Para comparar duas coisas, usamos o comparativo + than: The Palm is cheaper than the Sea Breeze (o Palm é mais barato que o Sea Breeze).

Adjetivos curtos (uma sílaba) ganham -er: cheap → cheaper, small → smaller. Atenção à ortografia: nice → nicer, big → bigger (dobra o g), e os que terminam em -y viram -ier: friendly → friendlier, easy → easier.
Adjetivos longos (duas sílabas ou mais) usam more antes: more expensive, more comfortable. Para "menos", usamos less: less comfortable.
Alguns são irregulares: good → better, bad → worse, far → farther.
Para dizer "tão … quanto", usamos as … as: Is the Palm as nice as the Sea Breeze? Na negativa: it isn't as expensive as the Sea Breeze.
Erros comuns: more cheap (o certo é cheaper), more better (o certo é só better) e that no lugar de than (o certo é cheaper than).

exercises.explanation: Falso: é o Palm que fica mais perto da praia ("It's also closer to the beach").

exercises.prompt: Por que o café da manhã do Sea Breeze era melhor?
options: Tinha frutas frescas, ovos e um café ótimo
exercises.explanation: O texto diz: "the breakfast was better: fresh fruit, eggs and great coffee".

exercises.statement: The author gave the Sea Breeze a better rating.
exercises.explanation: Verdadeiro: o Palm ganhou 3 de 5 e o Sea Breeze, 4 de 5.

exercises.sentence: The Palm is ___ than the Sea Breeze.
exercises.explanation: Cheap tem uma sílaba, então ganha -er: cheaper than.

exercises.sentence: The Sea Breeze is ___ expensive than the Palm.
exercises.explanation: Expensive é um adjetivo longo, então usamos more: more expensive than.

exercises.sentence: The breakfast at the Sea Breeze was ___ than at the Palm.
exercises.explanation: Good é irregular: good → better. Nunca more good nem more better.

options: This room is bigger than mine.
This room is more big than mine.
This room is bigger that mine.
exercises.explanation: Big é curto: bigger (com o g dobrado). E a comparação usa than, não that.

exercises.prompt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
exercises.explanation: Not as + adjetivo + as: The Palm isn't as expensive as the Sea Breeze.
